server.name: Saopaulo#5 (path saopaulo5 on host saopaulo3.<real-domain>)
server.note: The shuffle key that decodes every frame is the path (saopaulo5), so the game server is Sao Paulo #5; 'saopaulo3' is only the host name. INDEX.md is right, the task name (Sao Paulo #3) comes from the host.

time_base: t = seconds since ws_open (wall clock of the capture); row = line index in the capture file

decode.method: tools/sp3/decode.py with the saopaulo5 tables from the client's own shuffle (tools/sp3/learn_map.py, inert Node vm). rx: field codes via sp3_fieldmap.json; tx: base op = wire op ^ r, r ^= value of each re-key op (sp3 op 4).

tick.method: rx frames per 300 s window (median over windows); every server frame is one tick (frames arrive in bursts from the capture, so gaps are not used). Overall 28360 frames over 2711.2 s.

walk.unit: world units (same as create x/y and game memory)
walk.method: own position replayed from create + move records (1-byte x/y = delta: bit7 set = +(v-128), else -v; >=256 absolute; verified against the 2 s game-memory snapshots, stationary samples match exactly). Cruise tick = a frame whose displacement equals the previous 3 frames (+-1) with keys held. Grouped by the held item the server reports (own field 8) and by axis vs diagonal. Directions use the actual displacement (client key timing is jittery).
walk.note: Diagonal moves are normalised: |dx|=|dy|=speed/sqrt2. Speed depends on the held item: the item speed factor is the cruise speed over the hand speed.

accel.method: start: first moving frame after >= 6 still frames that reaches cruise within 4 frames; the speeds of the first 6 frames. stop: the first slower frame after >= 3 cruise frames, followed by a monotonic decay to 0 within 7 frames (collision stops are excluded by monotonic + reaching 0 smoothly is not guaranteed; check evidence).

collision.unit: world units, player center to object center while pushing into it
collision.method: blocked episode = >= 3 consecutive frames with a steady key set (>= 6 frames) whose displacement along the key direction is < 40% of the item cruise speed; the blocking entity = nearest entity (any category, not own pet) at the middle frame whose direction is within ~72 deg of the key direction and within 260 units. center_dist = radius_obj + radius_player. slide = frames in the episode with perpendicular motion > 2 units.

map_edge.method: extreme own positions over the session plus blocked episodes with no object nearby and the player within 400 of a border

blocked_no_object.method: blocked episodes with no entity within 260 units in the key direction and not at a border: candidates for terrain (water edge, river) or client/server key-state mismatch

contact_envelope.status: measured (lower envelope); a def counts as touched when several instances share the same minimum
contact_envelope.unit: world units, player center to object center
contact_envelope.method: for every static object (category 3) the closest own position over the whole session (all frames where the player moved or held a key). Solids cannot be entered, so the minimum over many instances = radius_obj + radius_player; non-solid defs (gifts, floors, plants you walk over) show near-zero minima. contact_dist = lowest minimum that a second instance confirms within 8 units (basis cluster), else the single lowest (basis single, less reliable). mobile_min_dist: same for other players (field 7 kind) and creatures.

value.damage_kind_field: 13 (1 on own/player hits; others 3,5,7 seen on other players)
value.food_instant_note: a heal of 6 or 3/4 at full HP is capped at 100 (the amount is what was actually healed)

hp.status: measured (amounts); causes estimated from the nearest entity at the damage frame
hp.method: own records with field 10 (damage) / 11 (heal) / 12 (hp). Cause = nearest other player < 330, else wild creature < 300 (field 22 kind), else hazard object < 200, else category-4 entity < 200. Heals in a frame that also carries field 15 (use animation, 350 ms for food) are food use (held item = server field 8); heals without it within 3.6 s after a food heal are heal-over-time ticks.

xp.method: XP total messages in order; delta per message; source = creature (no owner) removed within 350 of the player in the last 3 frames, else a static object hit record (field 8) in the same or previous 2 frames, else inventory change only.

value.field: type sp3 54 (atl4 53) 'i' = {slot: count}; join sends all slots, later only changed slots (absolute counts)

inventory.method: inventory deltas paired with object hits in the same XP frame

value.note: one XP per resource unit gathered: the XP delta of a hit equals the resources it gave

gather.method: XP frames paired with the static object hit record (field 8 = hit angle on the object) and the inventory delta in the same +-1 frames; grouped by object family and held item (server field 8 on own records).

swing.status: measured (bursty frame arrival widens the spread; use the median)
swing.unit: server frames (ticks) between own records with field 15 while the attack button is held; ms = frames * tick
swing.method: field 15 on the own record = use/swing animation (value = its duration in ms); interval between consecutive ones with the same held item and the attack op held (sp3 op 10 != 0), counted in server frames (frame arrival is bursty, frame count is not)

value.formula: age L starts at 20*L*(L+1)+1 XP (client), checked: the XP totals cross these thresholds; no dedicated age-up message was found in the frames at a crossing

age.status: measured (thresholds from the formula; server sends only the XP total)
age.method: age computed from each XP total with the client formula; frames at each crossing listed with their non-move messages

death_respawn.unit: t in s; field 24 in ms
death_respawn.method: frames from 0.3 s before the own hp-0 record to 4 s after the death message (type sp3 26 = atl4 6), non-move messages only; respawn exchange = all non-object messages within 1 s before/0.5 s after the next own_info join; shield = field 24 on own create/move records after spawn

value.afk_kick: not observed: no close, no warning message; the capture ends 112 s after the last input with the player alive and frames still arriving

idle.method: gaps between keyboard/mouse events (input records); rx/tx counted inside each gap; heartbeat = sp3 tx op 8 (atl4 8), value 0

field_guess.7: state (1 idle, 2 moving, 16 dead, 9 at spawn)

other_players.method: category-1 creates of non-own ids; record share = frames with a move/keepalive record for the id / frames the id was alive in view

creatures.status: measured (kinds, speeds); kind names from the client table (estimated mapping by table key)
creatures.method: category-0 creates; speeds = displacement between consecutive position updates of the same creature (per frame when it moves every frame)

render_distance.unit: world units, |object - own player| at create/remove time
render_distance.method: static objects (category 3); x edge from objects with |dy| < 500, y edge from |dx| < 700. Removes include destroyed objects (small offsets).

value.row_format: [entity_id, name, score, rank_badge(0..10), is_marked(only on some rows; 1 = crown/king)]; delta frames: 1 = row unchanged, [score] = score update for that row, full row = replaced
value.decrypt: plain[i] = chr(o[i] ^ o[i-1]) for i >= 1 (chained XOR; the setup key only decrypts o[0], which is always '['). Client: JSON.parse(_6437(o, (key + c) % 255)).

minimap_fields.ob: [x, y, boss kind] minimap boss marker

value.tx_format: JSON text frame [{type: 0 (sp3 json type of atl4 39), msg, tm: 1 (team/clan) or 0 (all)}, 1365]
value.rx_format: type sp3 0 (atl4 39): {i: sender entity id, m: text, mt: 1} (bubble) and {m, tm: clan id, s, n: sender name, p: sender id} (clan chat log)

client_ops.method: all tx frames; base op = wire op ^ r. JSON types use the same shuffled type table as rx (sp3 68 = atl4 1 join, 67 = atl4 28 token).

unknown.why: no reference of known size: contact distances give r_obj + r_player only; other players came within 51 units (no player-player collision or radii sum <= 51); map clamp 350/17250 does not give the map size
water is terrain, not sent as entities; no blocked episode could be tied to water (see blocked_no_object for unexplained stops)
no wild creature was killed by the player in the capture (no creature removal near the player paired with an XP change)
creatures carry an hp bar 0..255 (move field 9), not absolute HP; field 21 varies per instance
not observed: every damage frame had a nearby creature, player, hazard object or projectile
not reached: longest alive no-input stretch is the last 112 s of the capture, no warning or close
rare ops; values listed in client_ops
values listed in other_players.create_fields; meanings not confirmed
per_direction samples show the same magnitude for w/a/s/d (by_direction); no asymmetry found
frame arrival in the capture is bursty (gaps up to 400 ms then bursts), so client tx time vs server tick cannot be aligned better than a few frames

passive_regen: measured (92 s at 88 HP without change)
